mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: main thrust bearings from the 2024 production run reported as out of spec with insufficient interference fit, raising the risk of the thrust main spinning. The poster reports King technical support acknowledged the out-of-spec run and advised returning them.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official brand reply, thread open and not locked, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the OP reports switching to NOS Clevite thrust bearings that measured in spec.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Builder reports one shell in a King SI main set was malformed in production and arrived crushed and slightly twisted, and that King SI rod bearings came with machining shavings and oil in the shrink wrap. Other posters note a single bad shell in a box happens with other manufacturers too.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint about an incorrect bearing specification found in an XP series package, with the poster saying King should be embarrassed by a quality error of this kind. Warranty coverage was declined because the bearings came from a third-party distributor rather than King directly, which is the 'lack of professional help' the title refers to.
